spec.title: E-stop stops the belt
spec.text: While the E-stop (ESTOP) is pressed, MOTOR must be off in the same scan.

spec.title: Open guard stops the belt
spec.text: While the guard door is open (GUARD_CLOSED = 0), MOTOR must be off.

spec.title: STOP dominates
spec.text: While STOP is pressed, MOTOR must be off, even if START is pressed in the same scan.

spec.title: No automatic restart
spec.text: After any stop (STOP, E-stop, guard opened, or a fault shown on LAMP_RED) the belt may only run again after a new START press (rising edge). Pausing for a box at the pick position is not a stop: the belt resumes by itself once the robot has picked the box.

spec.title: E-stop needs a reset
spec.text: Once the E-stop has been pressed, LAMP_RED must stay on and MOTOR off until the E-stop is released AND RESET is pressed (rising edge). A RESET press while the E-stop is still pressed does not count.

spec.title: Stop at the pick position
spec.text: While PE_END sees a box (the pick position), MOTOR must be off in the same scan, or the box is pushed off the end of the belt (the end is 0.4 m past the point where PE_END first sees a box, which is 0.8 s at belt speed).

spec.title: Jam supervision
spec.text: If PE_IN stays blocked for 3.0 s while MOTOR runs (a jam, or a stuck sensor), the conveyor must stop, latch a fault shown on LAMP_RED, and stay stopped until PE_IN is clear and RESET is pressed, then START. Checked in simulation: MOTOR and PE_IN on together for more than 3.5 s is a violation.

spec.title: START runs the belt
spec.text: With the guard closed, no E-stop and no fault, a START press runs MOTOR immediately.

spec.title: Deliver and resume
spec.text: Boxes travel to the pick position and wait there with LAMP_AMBER on; after the robot picks a box the belt resumes without a new START.

spec.title: No false jam alarms
spec.text: A box waiting at the infeed while the belt is stopped is normal and must never raise a fault.

spec.title: Lamps
spec.text: LAMP_GREEN = belt running; LAMP_AMBER = in run mode but paused for a box at the pick position; LAMP_RED = E-stop latched or fault.

summary:
Four defects found and fixed:

1. **R02 — ESTOP_LATCH cleared without RESET (S5 violation)**
   - *Symptom:* Releasing the mushroom button immediately cleared ESTOP_LATCH with no RESET press required.
   - *Root cause:* Condition was `NOT ESTOP` alone.
   - *Fix:* Changed to `RISE(RESET) AND NOT ESTOP` so the latch only clears on a deliberate RESET press while the button is out.

2. **R06 — RUN latch not dropped by guard-open or ESTOP (S4 violation)**
   - *Symptom:* After the guard door re-closed or ESTOP was released, the motor restarted automatically without a new START press.
   - *Root cause:* The RUN seal-in expression did not include `GUARD_CLOSED`, so RUN stayed latched while the guard was open and immediately re-energised MOTOR when the guard closed.
   - *Fix:* Added `AND GUARD_CLOSED` to the RUN rung so RUN drops whenever the guard opens (or ESTOP is active via ESTOP_LATCH), requiring a fresh START to resume.

3. **R03 — Jam timer condition inverted (S7 violation + false FAULT)**
   - *Symptom (a):* A box waiting at the infeed before START caused a false FAULT (motor off, PE_IN=1 → timer ran and tripped).
   - *Symptom (b):* A genuine running jam (PE_IN blocked while motor running) was never detected.
   - *Root cause:* Timer condition was `PE_IN AND NOT MOTOR` — exactly backwards.
   - *Fix:* Changed to `PE_IN AND MOTOR` so the jam timer only accumulates while the belt is running and the infeed sensor stays blocked.

4. **R08 — Motor not stopped immediately on PE_END (S6 violation / box pushed off belt)**
   - *Symptom:* Box arrived at the pick position but the motor kept running for 1.2 s (T_END debounce), pushing the box off the end of the belt.
   - *Root cause:* MOTOR rung used `NOT T_END.Q`, gating the stop behind a 1.2 s timer.
   - *Fix:* Replaced `NOT T_END.Q` with `NOT PE_END` so the motor stops on the very scan that PE_END goes high. (T_END timer rung R07 is retained as it may be used for robot handshake signalling.)

steps.title: Read machine spec and operating rules
steps.detail:
MACHINE
Inputs: START, STOP, RESET (momentary push buttons, 1 while pressed), ESTOP (1 while the mushroom
button is pressed in), GUARD_CLOSED (1 when the interlocked guard door is closed), PE_IN (photo-eye at the
infeed, 1 when a box is in front of it), PE_END (photo-eye at the pick position).
Outputs: MOTOR (belt drive), LAMP_GREEN, LAMP_AMBER, LAMP_RED (stack light).
Plant: the belt is 4.0 m long and moves at 0.5 m/s while MOTOR = 1. Boxes are 0.4 m long, placed at the
infeed (x = 0.2 m). PE_IN sits at x = 0.3 m, PE_END at x = 3.7 m. A robot picks boxes waiting at PE_END.
The PLC scans every 0.1 s.

CONTROL LANGUAGE
Each rung is one statement; rungs run top to bottom every 0.1 s scan.
  COIL = expr                  assign (every scan)
  SET COIL WHEN expr           latch on
  RESET COIL WHEN expr         latch off
  TON T_NAME(expr, 3.0s)       on-delay timer; T_NAME.Q is 1 once expr has been 1 for the preset time
expr uses NOT, AND, OR, parentheses, TRUE/FALSE, signal names, T_NAME.Q and RISE(X) (1 for the scan in
which X goes from 0 to 1). A coil read before the rung that writes it holds its value from the previous
scan. Inputs cannot be written. Limits: 24 rungs, 12 internal coils, 4 timers, presets 0.1-10 s,
12 contacts per rung.

OPERATING RULES
S1 E-stop stops the belt [safety]: While the E-stop (ESTOP) is pressed, MOTOR must be off in the same scan.
S2 Open guard stops the belt [safety]: While the guard door is open (GUARD_CLOSED = 0), MOTOR must be off.
S3 STOP dominates [safety]: While STOP is pressed, MOTOR must be off, even if START is pressed in the same scan.
S4 No automatic restart [safety]: After any stop (STOP, E-stop, guard opened, or a fault shown on LAMP_RED) the belt may only run again after a new START press (rising edge). Pausing for a box at the pick position is not a stop: the belt resumes by itself once the robot has picked the box.
S5 E-stop needs a reset [safety]: Once the E-stop has been pressed, LAMP_RED must stay on and MOTOR off until the E-stop is released AND RESET is pressed (rising edge). A RESET press while the E-stop is still pressed does not count.
S6 Stop at the pick position [safety]: While PE_END sees a box (the pick position), MOTOR must be off in the same scan, or the box is pushed off the end of the belt (the end is 0.4 m past the point where PE_END first sees a box, which is 0.8 s at belt speed).
S7 Jam supervision [safety]: If PE_IN stays blocked for 3.0 s while MOTOR runs (a jam, or a stuck sensor), the conveyor must stop, latch a fault shown on LAMP_RED, and stay stopped until PE_IN is clear and RESET is pressed, then START. Checked in simulation: MOTOR and PE_IN on together for more than 3.5 s is a violation.
F1 START runs the belt [functional]: With the guard closed, no E-stop and no fault, a START press runs MOTOR immediately.
F2 Deliver and resume [functional]: Boxes travel to the pick position and wait there with LAMP_AMBER on; after the robot picks a box the belt resumes without a new START.
F3 No false jam alarms [functional]: A box waiting at the infeed while the belt is stopped is normal and must never raise a fault.
F4 Lamps [functional]: LAMP_GREEN = belt running; LAMP_AMBER = in run mode but paused for a box at the pick position; LAMP_RED = E-stop latched or fault.

steps.title: Excellent. Now I have a complete picture of all four defects. Let me analyze them:
steps.detail:
Excellent. Now I have a complete picture of all four defects. Let me analyze them:

---

**Root-cause analysis:**

1. **R02 — ESTOP_LATCH clears without RESET (V03, S5):** `RESET ESTOP_LATCH WHEN NOT ESTOP` clears the latch the moment the mushroom button is released, with no RESET press required. Fix: require `RISE(RESET)`.

2. **R06 — RUN re-seals automatically after guard/ESTOP clears (V03, V04, S4):** After ESTOP or guard interrupts the motor, `RUN` stays latched (it was never cleared by ESTOP or guard-open). When the condition clears, MOTOR comes back on without a new START press. Fix: add `AND NOT ESTOP_LATCH AND GUARD_CLOSED` to the seal-in so that RUN drops when either condition is true and requires a fresh START.

3. **R03 — Jam timer condition wrong (V06, V07, S7):** `PE_IN AND NOT MOTOR` — the timer only runs when the motor is *off*. But a real jam means PE_IN is blocked *while the motor is running*. Fix: condition should be `PE_IN AND MOTOR`. Also, this causes a false FAULT in V07 (box at infeed before START — motor is off, PE_IN=1, timer runs and trips FAULT).

4. **R07 — T_END timer stops the motor too late (V01, V05, S6):** The timer uses a 1.2 s debounce before stopping the motor, but the box reaches PE_END and the motor keeps running, pushing the box off the belt. The motor must stop as soon as PE_END is asserted (or with minimal debounce). Fix: `MOTOR` should cut on `PE_END` directly (i.e., `NOT PE_END`), removing the timer delay — or set T_END preset to 0s. Looking at the spec, the timer is meant to confirm the box is truly at the pick position; but S6 says motor must not run with a box at pick position. The simplest correct fix is to stop the motor immediately on PE_END: replace `NOT T_END.Q` with `NOT PE_END` in R08, and keep T_END for any other purpose — or simply change the preset to 0.1s (one scan). Actually the cleanest fix is `NOT PE_END` directly in R08.

Now let me apply all four fixes in one patch:

args.rationale:
Four defects found:
1. R02: ESTOP_LATCH cleared by NOT ESTOP alone — must require RISE(RESET) (S5 violation).
2. R06: RUN latch not gated on GUARD_CLOSED or absence of ESTOP_LATCH, so motor auto-restarts after guard re-closes or ESTOP releases without a new START (S4 violation). Add AND GUARD_CLOSED to the seal-in condition so RUN drops when guard opens or ESTOP is active.
3. R03: Jam timer condition is PE_IN AND NOT MOTOR — fires when motor is OFF and box is present (false fault at startup with box waiting), and never fires during a real running jam. Correct condition is PE_IN AND MOTOR.
4. R08/R07: Motor stops only after T_END.Q (1.2 s after PE_END goes high), letting the box get pushed off the belt. Must stop immediately on PE_END. Replace NOT T_END.Q with NOT PE_END in the MOTOR rung.
